title: The logo, favicon and pages answers change Joomla and EmDash sites too: Joomla T3 template styles and T4 site profiles through template.siteSettings (plugin 0.23.0), EmDash through the template tool's brand-only run; unticked EmDash pages are unpublished in every locale and leave the menu; the tone reaches the EmDash copy prompt as the voice
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run: node --test apps/tracy-web/test/brief-brand-joomla.test.mjs
S3: From packages/cms/tracy-emdash-theme-business run: node --test tests/personalize-brand.test.mjs tests/personalize-pages.test.mjs tests/personalize-tone.test.mjs
S4: Read the exit code and the fail/skipped counts of each run.
expect: Every run exits 0 with 0 failures and 0 skipped tests.

Joomla T3: every template style takes the light or dark logo its profile names (JA Smallbiz four styles, JA Mood 'Home Dark' the dark one), every other param kept; the favicon goes through template.siteSettings other_faviconFile; plugin 0.22.0 writes the logo and skips the favicon as plugin too old.

Joomla T4: one template.siteSettings set with site_logo and site_logo_dark plus one content.contract apply on the footer slot; file names are new on every run and never a template file; apply.revert of every recorded id puts the site back.

EmDash: the tool runs with --brand-only, the three files and the apply id; settings.logo, settings.favicon and the chrome entry's logo_dark land on the site and --revert takes all of it back; a picture the tool could not write is a skip with its reason, and nothing fails the build.
EmDash pages: an unticked id is unpublished in every written language and its menu items are removed, --revert brings both back; the home page is never hidden.
EmDash tone: the tone reaches the copy prompt as the voice beside the description; no tone leaves the prompt as it was.
evidence: 07/10/2026: seven default questions must change the site on WordPress, Joomla and EmDash for every gallery template (issue #1013 phases 2 and 3, plan tasks/plan-ten-logo-favicon.md).
fence: Units over a fake Joomla Apply door and the real EmDash template tool on a local site fixture. Not exercised here: a running Joomla with Claude Cowork 0.23.0, a deployed EmDash theme release, the dev surface.
